sum: Elicio Therapeutics, Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company, develops immunotherapies for the treatment of cancer. Its lead product candidate, ELI-002, is a multivalent lymph node-targeted amphiphile (AMP) peptide vaccine that is in Phase II clinical trials for seven Kirsten rat sarcoma viral oncogene homolog driver mutations. The company also develops ELI-007, a multivalent lymph node-targeted AMP peptide treatment for mutant b-raf murine sarcoma viral oncogene homolog B1-(BRAF) driven cancers, and ELI-008, a multivalent lymph node-targeted AMP peptide vaccine in preclinical studies for the treatment of mutated tumor protein p53-expressing cancers. Elicio Therapeutics, Inc. is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.
ceo: Mr. Robert T. Connelly (CEO, President & Director)
